answer: Each agent locks 70 credits, firing a kiln per epoch; the beacon pairs it with a random peer auditor across the bridge. The audited agent shows plume density and fresh serial. It shows the opal glaze hue. The auditor recomputes both from public tables within 3%; mismatch or reused serial burns it. First fake 38, kth 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500, 70,000 locked. Rented-kiln rings fail on single-use serials; honest pays 38 once, bond back.
